method: Three ordinary pictures inspected;standard viewer PMTiles andglobal Terrarium only.

references.name: aerial
references.observed: Whole aerial actually inspected: connected red/brown brick palace with three open internal courts, several different eaves and slate/lead roofs, long dormered private ranges, tall brick chimneys, a clock-stage/white open lantern above one court and a real ground arch below it. East State Apartments have a projecting pedimented central pavilion,hipped corner roofs andlower pale basement strip;entire attached northern/western fabric must be retained.

references.name: south
references.observed: South public front actually inspected: broad two-level red-brick elevation with tall rectangular sash windows,brick pilasters,pale dentil cornice andlow hipped roof. Raised central brick attic with pale urns. Open metal gate gap/railings infront;do not copy royal arms or private graphics. Garden/statue remain independent context.

references.name: east
references.observed: East front actually inspected: varying roof/eave heights,pedimented center withblank pale arched tablet,hipped southern pavilion,two principal window floors andpale basement. Projecting shallow green/metal/glazed entrance canopy withcloseddoors;attached long northern dormered range is integral. Independent Victoria statue/pool andformal gardens remain context.
